version.author: LMS
version.changelog: Initial release — shared DSP kernel. All LMS plugins import this. Contains: tanh/dB math, stereo biquad filters (HP/LP/BP/peak/shelf), saturation suite (warm/hot/tape/rect/fuzz/harmonics), FET compressor, DC blocker, tone filter, cubic interpolation, spring reverb allpass.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.0 — Density-aware amp ecosystem support. Core kernel now used by Frenchie v2 (Champ), Punk Idol v2 (JCM800), The Fridge v2 (SVT), Top Boost v2 (AC15), and The TRSOB v2 (Mesa Triple Rectifier) density-aware amp sims with built-in effects (spring reverb, tremolo, tape echo, Crushinator).

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v3.0 — Density-aware saturation replaces ADAA waveshaper. All 5 sat modes (warm/hot/tape/rect/fuzz) now use same triode architecture as v2 amp sims: coupling cap bias shift, 4-band density tracker (Lo/Mid/Hi/Air), density-driven drive boost, grid conduction (peak envelope gated soft clamp), Miller LP (density-driven cutoff), air shelf (density-driven HF), DC blocker. Fixes crash on load in tube sat and all plugins using sat functions (uninitialized ADAA state caused spike on first sample). Added mono lms_bq_proc to biquad section.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v3.1 — Removed 926 lines of dead legacy code: ADAA triode stages, EL34/6L6 power amps, Marshall/Mesa tone stacks and cabinet sims, sag simulator, opto compressor, cascaded saturation, ADAA antiderivative primitives. All superseded by density-aware v2 amp sims. Core is now 720 clean lines.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v3.2 — Fix: lms_gfx_notice() forward-declaration error (moved above lms_gfx_notice_btn). GUI helpers section added.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v4.0 — Section 12: Pitch Detection & Correction. YIN pitch detector (lms_yin_init/write/detect — monophonic vocal pitch tracking with cumulative mean normalized difference, parabolic interpolation, built-in confidence). Dual-tap pitch shifter (lms_pshift_init/proc — sin^2 crossfaded variable delay for click-free pitch shifting, uses lms_interp_cubic). Scale snap helper (lms_snap_to_scale — bitmask-based scale lookup). Scale mask constants (LMS_SCALE_CHROMATIC/MAJOR/MINOR). Powers the new LMS Pitch Detector and LMS Autotune plugins.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v4.1 — Opto density tracker (lms_opto_hd_init/proc) exposed as standalone 4-band voiced/unvoiced classifier for pitch detection intelligence. Used by both LMS Pitch Detector and LMS Autotune for density-gated YIN decimation. No API changes to existing functions.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v5.0 — Section 13: Cabinet Simulation. 7 real-world cabinet models (1x12 Greenback, 1x12 Jensen C12N, 1x12 Alnico Blue, 2x12 Jensen, 4x12 G12T-75, 4x12 V30, 8x10 SVT Sealed) as shared table-driven presets — any amp can load any cab. Density-aware speaker breakup: bandpass-extracted cone breakup band → envelope follower → density-scaled tanh saturation mixed as parallel harmonics. Dynamic LP darkens top end under load (real cone stiffening). Dynamic resonance excites cabinet body proportional to excursion. Mic position simulation: off-axis hi-shelf rolloff + proximity effect bass reversal. GUI: clickable cab selector widget (lms_draw_cab_sel), chromatic tuner strip (lms_draw_tuner — note name, cents meter with color-coded accuracy, frequency readout). All 6 density-aware amp sims now share the cab system.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v5.1 — 5 new cabinet presets: Sheffield 1x15 Open (open-back bass cab, 45Hz tuning, warm LP at 4kHz), 4x10 Sealed (Orange OBC410 bass cab, 50Hz HP, 90Hz resonance, tight 4.5kHz LP), 4x12 Closed (closed-back 4x12 V30, 1.5kHz bark peak, 110Hz resonance — THE Orange sound). Also added 1x15 Open preset. CAB_PRESET_COUNT now 12. All existing amp sims updated with expanded cab selector (12 cabinets).

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v5.2 — Dual cab + impedance matching. New functions: lms_cab_get_ohms(preset_id) returns nominal impedance per cab preset, lms_cab_compute_load(ohms_a, ohms_b) computes parallel load impedance for dual-cab rigs. New GUI widget: lms_draw_cab_sel_b() (Cab B selector, same click behavior as Cab A). Cab A selector relabeled from "Cabinet" to "Cab A". All 10 density-aware amp sims now support dual cab (Cab A + Cab B in parallel) with impedance tap selector and load mismatch modeling.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v5.3 — Tuner Module. Section 13: Tuner module (lms_tuner_init/write/block/draw) wraps YIN pitch detection, display smoothing, and click-to-toggle on/off UI into 4 functions — zero CPU when tuner is off. All 11 amp sims refactored to call tuner module instead of inline code.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v5.4 — Section 10B: Opto Lite. Lightweight T4B photocell compressor for percussive sources (drums, transients). Same physics as full opto (EL square-law brightness, CdS power-law resistance, two-stage release) but stripped of density tracker, memory accumulation, sidechain emphasis, and tube warmth. Feedforward topology, fixed envelope times (10ms attack, 60ms/1s two-stage release), all coefficients pre-computed in init. API: lms_opto_lite_init/set/proc.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.0 — Section 8b: Built-in Effects moved to core. Spring reverb (lms_spring_init/proc), tremolo (lms_trem_init/proc), and tape echo (lms_tape_echo_init/proc) consolidated from 11 amp plugins into shared core functions. Per-sample parameter smoothing (10ms time constant) eliminates zipper noise during automation. Soft clamp on wet signals prevents clipping at high mix levels. Spring reverb voicing is configurable via spring_coeff/spring_wet for per-amp tuning (Fender amps use brighter 3-spring tank settings).

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.1 — Replace YIN tuner with zero-crossing pitch detector. New tuner module uses LP-filtered zero-crossing detection with envelope gating — simpler, more reliable, no buffer allocations. Adds tuner mute with 5ms fade to all amps. Reverts YIN init to original hardcoded buffer sizes (keeps YIN available for autotune).

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: Core refactor: all shared DSP extracted to lms_core. Zero audible/visual change. -30% codebase.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.3 — Two new pedal primitives. lms_ts_* — Ibanez TS-808/TS-9 Tube Screamer (720Hz input HP creates the mid-hump, asymmetric soft clip with 0.90/0.55 coefficients for even-harmonic bias, log-swept tone LP 400Hz-5kHz, clipped path mixed 70/30 with a touch of pre-clip signal so low end survives). lms_paraeq_* — 4-band parametric EQ (HP, low shelf, single mid peak, presence peak, high shelf) with Punk/Jazz/Metal/Flat voicings: mode sets the frequencies and Qs (the character), gain knobs drive each band directly. Used by the new Satan's Little Pedal Board.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.4 — Tuner module rebuilt. lms_tuner_* now wraps lms_yin_* (autocorrelation pitch detector) instead of the old zero-crossing detector — rock-solid tracking on guitar/bass-range fundamentals. New UI: huge note name with octave subscript, color-zoned cents meter with needle, frequency readout, IN-TUNE LED with halo, click-to-toggle MUTE button (5ms ramped silence for silent stage tuning), and a PWR button so detection runs only when needed. Detection rate decimated to every 4th block to keep CPU low. lms_yin_init now takes an optional min_freq parameter and packs its workspace tightly — the tuner uses min_freq=55 to handle every drop tuning down to drop A. Faker and Pitch Detector are unaffected (default min_freq=80 preserves their old footprint).

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.5 — lms_fast_tanh: Padé rational tanh approximation (no exp call) for tight per-sample loops. Used by Huovilainen Moog ladder filters in Nuug420 and Lil Stinker. Same accuracy as lms_tanh in audio range, ~16x faster.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.6 — Speaker breakup slider. lms_cab_proc now takes a user-controllable breakup amount parameter, allowing per-amp speaker breakup intensity control from 0-100%. All 11 amp sims updated with new Speaker Breakup slider.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.7 — DSP corrections from Linus Torvalds C port review. DC blocker: add missing 2*pi factor (cutoff was 3.2Hz instead of 20Hz). Peaking EQ: fix A=10^(dB/20) to correct A=10^(dB/40), all callsites compensated. Klon presence peak doubled to match. Mouse capture system for draw_bar sliders.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.8 — LR4 crossover (lms_lr4_init/proc — Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order lo/hi split for sidechain frequency targeting). Transformer hysteresis (lms_pp_pa_hyst/lms_se_pa_hyst — B-H loop model: magnetization state chases anhysteretic tanh curve with nonlinear directional lag, creates even harmonics on signal reversals and bloom on power chords; width scaled per amp 0.05-0.15). Miller LP opens to 15-18kHz at low density for clean sparkle, closes to base freq only at max density, 150ms smoother prevents sweep artifacts. Tone stack recovery scales with gain (1+gain*N) instead of fixed multiplier — gain at zero gives true clean headroom.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v6.9 — Fix YIN buffer overflow at high sample rates (96kHz+). Buffer now scales with sample rate to prevent writes past allocation.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.0 — lms_draw_mode_sel refactored from 12 to 7 params using string buffer (MS_BUF 990+). All amp/fx call sites updated. Fixes Room material label bug where only 5 of 8 materials could be displayed.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.1 — gmem address space documented and organised. lms_core.jsfx-inc now carries the one authoritative map of the shared global memory every LMS plugin writes into, and global region constants take a G_ prefix so they can be told apart from local memory at a glance — the two look identical in JSFX source and confusing them has already produced one wrong bug report. tools/gmem_audit.py resolves every gmem access back to its region and fails on anything undeclared. No address changed: all 481 resolvable accesses verified byte-identical before and after.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.2 — gmem map updated: The Space is retired, so nothing writes the room master heartbeat at 900000 and Space Send currently has no room to talk to. Also records that the band slots at 800010 have no writer.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.3 — SECTION 15: source rings, cross-track audio over gmem. A satellite publishes its track's audio into a ring; a room on another track reads it back sample-aligned by snapshotting the write position once per block and walking forward. Same mechanism as the bleed engine, reduced to just the transport. Needed because a single gmem cell cannot carry audio between tracks: REAPER runs a whole block per track, so the cell only ever holds the writer's last sample.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.4 — Fix the source-ring consumer losing continuity when REAPER changes block size. It read at (writer position - samplesblock), but the writer position had advanced by the PREVIOUS block's length while the read subtracted the CURRENT one, so any short block slipped the read window. Constant block sizes hid it entirely. The consumer now keeps its own read pointer, advances it by what it actually consumed, and resyncs only when the writer has not left a full block. Simulated clean against steady buffers, loop-point short blocks, 441/512 mixtures and buffer changes.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.5 — Power amp density tracker is now initialised. lms_pp_pa_proc, lms_se_pa_proc and lms_classd_pa_proc all read this.hd, but nothing ever initialised it, so its filters had zero coefficients and output silence: env_lo stayed 0 and the xfmr_sat > 0.05 gate never opened. Transformer saturation and hysteresis were unreachable in every amp. Measured over a second of low E the gate fires 0 times out of 48,000 before and 47,976 after. THIS CHANGES HOW THE AMPS SOUND — low end thickens. Winding resonance was unaffected throughout. Also: lms_spring_init, lms_tape_echo_init and lms_lim_init take an optional explicit buffer base via _at() variants, since each hardcoded one and two instances in a plugin would shred each other; local memory bases are now documented alongside the gmem map; lms_lim_init no longer zeroes its buffer with a bare i, which in JSFX is a global and clobbered the host plugin's; and the duplicate density tracker in Section 10 is gone, verified character-identical to the canonical one before removal.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.6 — Source rings survive anticipative FX processing. REAPER renders each track ahead on its own thread by different amounts, so a satellite can run hundreds of milliseconds in front of the room reading it. Two constants were sized as though it could not: the ring held 8192 samples, 186 ms at 44.1k, less than the 200 ms REAPER renders ahead by default, so it wrapped and resynced; and a publisher was declared gone after 20 quiet blocks, 232 ms, while rendering ahead delivers heartbeats in bursts with longer gaps than that. Sources dropped in and out one at a time, taking their reflections with them, which is heard as a wobble. The ring is now 32768 samples (743 ms at 44.1k, 341 ms at 96k) and the liveness timeout 200 blocks. G_SRC_RINGS grows from 65536 to 262144; no other region moves.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.7 — The source-ring consumer had nowhere to keep its state. lms_srcring_con_init took no arguments and never assigned a base to any of its four per-slot arrays, and in EEL that is not an empty array, it is address 0: this.alive[k] means mem[this.alive + k], and an unassigned variable is 0. snap, rpos, alive and last_hb were therefore the same eight cells, overwriting each other every block, and lms_room bump allocates from 0 as well, so those cells are also the head of its delay line. Simulated over 400 blocks: the read position ended each block holding the writer's position instead of one block behind it, so the room read from a wandering point in the ring — chopped, repeating fragments — and a live source was declared dead on 12 blocks out of 400, which is heard as sources blinking in and out. With its own buffer: a steady one-block lag and no false deaths. con_init now takes a local_buf_base and needs SRC_MAX_SLOTS * 4 cells, the same pattern Section 14's bleed engine has always used, which is why that one never had this fault. Callers must pass a base.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v7.8 — A source that stops publishing goes quiet instead of holding a note. Liveness was decided by the publisher's heartbeat, which only says its @block ran; the write position is the signal that cannot lie, because a live source writes a block of samples every block even when it is silent. A stalled write head meant the reader resynced to the same block every block and read it over and over — a 20ms loop, which is a sustained tone in the voice of whatever that source last played, not a dropout. Raising the liveness timeout to 200 blocks in 7.6 made it last ten times longer. Liveness now drains fast when the write head is not moving, and a slot with nothing new to read returns silence rather than replaying the block it already played. Simulated over 200 blocks after a source stalls: 120+ blocks of replayed audio before, 0 after.

version.changelog: v1.1 — gmem address space documented and organised. lms_core.jsfx-inc now carries the one authoritative map of the shared global memory every LMS plugin writes into, and global region constants take a G_ prefix so they can be told apart from local memory at a glance — the two look identical in JSFX source and confusing them has already produced one wrong bug report. tools/gmem_audit.py resolves every gmem access back to its region and fails on anything undeclared. No address changed: all 481 resolvable accesses verified byte-identical before and after.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.2 — Room Juice. The tail damping is normally fixed by the wall materials; Room Juice lets a 4-band density read of the reverb feed move it, so the room responds to what is played in it. Bright opens the tail with air content, Moody thickens it with low and mid content and lengthens the feedback slightly. Ported from The Space, where it was called Vibe, since The Space is retired in favour of this plugin.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.3 — Band mode works. It read each source from one gmem cell per sample, which could never have carried audio across tracks, and nothing wrote those cells anyway. Sources now arrive through the source rings in lms_core, with slot liveness from the ring handshake.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.4 — Uses the canonical density tracker in lms_core; the Section 10 duplicate it called has been removed. Requires lms_core 7.5 or later.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.5 — Band mode is normalised for how many sources are in the room. wet_norm is computed over a single source's tap set, so each source that joined arrived at a level the normalisation did not account for: a full band delivered up to eight times the energy the room was scaled for, which is a large part of why it rang. The wet path is now scaled by the square root of the live source count — sources are uncorrelated, so their power sums — and the scaling is smoothed so a source joining or dropping out does not step the tail. Single mode is unchanged.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.6 — Room Juice has controls. Both its sliders were live in the DSP and drawn nowhere, so on the panel the feature did not exist — it was reachable only through REAPER's generic parameter list. A ROOM JUICE panel now carries Off/Bright/Moody and Amount. Reverb Tail gains a control too: the only thing that touched that slider was a leftover 3-way "Depth" selector in PLACEMENT, from when it chose a reflection order, and clicking it wrote 0, 1 or 2 into what is now Tail % — which all but removes the tail. Depth is gone and Tail % sits in OUTPUT with Mix and Gain. The window is 700 tall to fit the extra panel. Requires lms_core 7.6 for the source-ring sizing.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.7 — Allocates the source-ring consumer's state instead of letting it land on address 0, which is the head of delay_buf: see lms_core 7.7 for what that cost. Requires lms_core 7.7. Also publishes what it can see, so it can be read from outside: a build stamp at G_ROOM_STATE +1/+2 carrying the ring constants this plugin was compiled with, since editing an include changes nothing until something recompiles and there is otherwise no way to tell which build is running; and the room's own per-slot view at +10, its liveness countdown, verdict and read position. gmem only ever carried the publisher's half of the handshake, so a source could publish perfectly while the room ignored it with nothing to see.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.8 — Band sources can be moved from outside. The room still owns where a source stands: it clamps into the polygon, recomputes the reflections and serialises the result, so a mover proposes a position at the slot's request cell and the room applies it. The request is consumed and zeroed when it lands, so the last word wins during a drag and a stale cell cannot pull the source back a block later. A metre coordinate inside the room is never 0, which is what makes 0 a safe "nothing pending". Lets the manager's room plan place the band directly instead of sending you to the plugin window.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.9 — A source that leaves the room takes its delay line with it. band_wr only advances while a slot is active, so a dropped source's buffer kept its last 32768 samples indefinitely, and the taps read behind the write head — so the moment that slot came back the room played out audio from whenever it left, as held notes from an instrument that was not playing. The buffer, its write head and its level are cleared on the way out. Requires lms_core 7.8, which fixes the other half of the same symptom.

version.changelog: v2.7 — Strip All Sends in the Room Verb tab: deletes every Bluhm Send in the project, including the ones on folder children that setup skips on purpose and therefore never renumbers. version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.8 — Plugins are identified by their FILE, not by the name REAPER shows. REAPER caches a JSFX's desc line when it scans it and serves that until something makes it rescan, so a rename leaves every project identifying the plugin by the old name: reaper-jsfx.ini on the machine this was found on still read NAME "lms_room_send.jsfx" "JS: LMS - Space Send" months after the desc became "Bluhm Send". Every name-based check missed it, so the manager added a second send on each run, Strip All Sends removed nothing, and the plugin never appeared in the Overview — one cause, three symptoms. All seven identification sites now read fx_ident, with name matching kept only as a fallback. Also: drag sources and the mic directly on the room plan, the mic being a plain parameter and the sources going through the room, which owns their placement. One Bluhm Send per track is now enforced by deleting extras rather than assumed from a lookup — a second send publishes into a ring of its own, is never renumbered, and ends up writing over a slot that belongs to another track — and sends stranded on folder children, which setup skips and therefore never renumbers, are removed the same way. Both are reported. Bluhm Send gains a registry entry so it reads as itself rather than as its lookup key, with a slider count of zero so follow and steal cannot copy one send's slot identity onto another.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: Initial release — Density-aware Vox AC15 amp sim. EF86 pentode preamp (soft positive/HARD negative cutoff — the AC15 "glass") with 12AX7 second stage on Top Boost channel. EL84 cathode-biased push-pull power amp with NO negative feedback (raw, alive, touch-sensitive), cathode bias shift for natural compression. Top Boost EQ with built-in mid presence peak (the chime). Tone Cut (back panel LP). Celestion Alnico Blue 1x12 cab sim with 2.5kHz presence peak. Built-in bias tremolo and spring reverb. Normal/Top Boost channel switching. 20% PSU sag with spongy feel.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.1 — Six AC15 circuit additions from real schematic: (1) Cathodyne phase inverter — real AC15 uses cathodyne (concertina), NOT long-tail pair like Marshall. Wider bandwidth = more HF (Vox shimmer). Plate clips harder than cathode (asymmetric bloom under drive). (2) Output transformer saturation — small 15W EL84 OT (×3.5 sensitivity at ~90Hz), density-driven low-frequency core loading creates creamy breakup on power chords. (3) Transformer winding resonance — 4kHz +2.0dB peak (the Vox shimmer, between Champ 3.5k and Mesa 4.5k). version.changelog: v1.0 — ReaImGui-based central control plane for the entire LMS suite. Overview tab: track-centric layout with inline rename, mute/solo, FX bypass. Broadcast tab: follow/steal management for all plugin types via TrackFX_GetParam/SetParam — plugins are pure audio processors. DrumBanger tab: interactive pad control, auto-create track, MIDI output. Harmony Map tab: read-only song structure display, Song Builder presets, Sync Markers. Drone Voice tab: per-slot role/octave/velocity/arp config with project-persistent settings. version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.2 — Fix "ImGui_CreateImage: No such file or directory" on startup. The header logo path was built from the git checkout layout (repo root, one level above scripts/), but ReaPack ships shakebot_logo.png as a data source, which installs to <resource>/Data. The manager now checks both layouts and wraps image creation in pcall, so a missing or unreadable logo degrades to a header without an image instead of aborting the script.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.3 — Fix "Create Track" buttons building an empty track on other people's rigs. The DrumBanger, Harmony Map, Drone Voice, Track Setup and Room buttons all inserted FX using a hardcoded "LMS Plugins/LMS/" path. That folder name is not fixed: under ReaPack it is "<remote name>/<category>", and the remote name is chosen by whoever imports the repo, while a manual install uses a different layout again. On any rig that named the remote differently, TrackFX_AddByName returned -1, and because the result was never checked the track was created and named with an empty FX bin and no error. JSFX are now located by searching <resource>/Effects for the file and using the path actually found, with the old prefix and bare filename as fallbacks. Failures are reported to the ReaScript console (never a modal dialog, which would let ReaImGui collect the context mid-frame) and point at Preferences > Plug-ins > JS > Re-scan, since REAPER cannot insert a JSFX it has not scanned.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.4 — Fix the DrumBanger tab not seeing a loaded DrumBanger (and the same fault for The Faker, Lil Stinker and NUUG 420). Instances were matched with inst.lms_name == "lms_drumbanger", but that key is not a stable identifier: TrackFX_GetFXName returns REAPER's display name ("JS: LMS DRUMBANGER"), not the filename, so the underscored JSFX_TO_TYPE lookup misses and DISPLAY_TO_TYPE answers instead, setting lms_name to "drumbanger". The comparison could never be true, so the tab kept reporting no instance even with the plugin loaded and its heartbeat running. All four lookups now compare inst.type_id, which is identical whichever table matched — the same approach the Harmony Map tab already used, which is why that tab worked and these did not.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.5 — Correct the advice printed when an FX cannot be inserted. It pointed at Options > Preferences > Plug-ins > JS > Re-scan, which is not a button that exists; REAPER scans the Effects folder on launch, so the fix is simply to restart REAPER. Same correction applied to the install steps in the README, along with the Windows Effects path, which assumed %APPDATA% and is wrong for portable installs.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.6 — Overview: track headers stay where you put them (expanding one now selects that track in REAPER instead of the selection forcing headers shut), and Colorize All Tracks / Organize all FX / Add RTW to all tracks move here from Track Setup and Broadcast. Amps get a swap caret: pick any other amp and it takes over the same chain slot, bypass state and all. Space starts and stops the transport while the manager has focus. Metering gains an Add Mega Increasinator to Master button. Broadcast loses Dump to console. Fixes Send FX (right-click a track header) erroring out: copy_fx_chain was defined after its only caller, so the call hit a nil global.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.7 — Metering page rebuilt around MEGA's new output analyser: integrated LUFS as the headline with momentary and short-term meters, a 12-band output spectrum with peak hold, output peak against the limiter ceiling, and the post-limiter density tracker. Reset button for integrated loudness.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.8 — Spectrum overlays the input as an outline behind the output bars, so the reactive EQ's move is visible rather than just its result. Align levels (on by default) subtracts the broadband difference so the comparison shows shape rather than makeup gain. Reads out the EQ's live band gains, and says which of profile-or-opto is missing when it is idle.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v1.9 — Metering: density now uses the amps' DENSITY AWARENESS matrix -- 16x8 animated cells, LO blue / MID orange / HI red / AIR purple -- sized to match the spectrum above it, so density reads the same everywhere in the suite and the page is not four more shades of green. Harmony arp: the 12-way chromatic interval combo is replaced by a 1-8 chord-tone offset.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.0 — Remove the Song buttons from the Harmony Map tab. They wrote gmem[960096], which flips a song_mode flag that only shows or hides the song panel inside the plugin's own window and gates no behaviour: the plugin runs a song whenever one exists. Where the button sat in the Song Structure section there is now a status line saying so. Also fixes 19 widgets across six groups that shared ImGui ids — ImGui takes everything after ## as the id and discards the label, so "Key##hm", "Mode##hm" and "Steps##hm" were all one widget as far as it was concerned. The two Song buttons were the same bug, both being ##hm_song.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.1 — Fix the readouts on the metering bars showing as a lone dash. The bar filled the full width it was given and the value was drawn past the end of it, outside the content region, so ImGui clipped every glyph but the leading minus sign. The bars now reserve a gutter for the readout and right-align it, and the gutter is measured from a fixed template so bar length no longer twitches as the digits change.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.2 — Black In Bluhm gained two sliders (Room Juice), so its parameter count is corrected from 22 to 24 — follow and steal copy by count and would have missed them.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.3 — Fix six plugins being invisible in the manager. It identifies a plugin by looking for a lookup-table key inside the name REAPER displays, and six descs contained no key: OJ 95 (desc has a space, the key did not), TOMASTEKNIK (the reverse), PEQ4U and Kitty Kats Big Krush (desc bears no relation to the key), Bluhm Send (renamed, key never added) and Bloody Glue (never had one). They could not be seen in the Overview, followed, or stolen from — and an amp swapped to OJ 95 appeared to vanish. Added tools/name_audit.py so a desc rename cannot silently drop a plugin out again. Room Verb also gains "Prepare for Band Mode": a Bluhm Send on every top-level track with slots assigned, and the room switched to Band. Folder children are skipped, since the folder parent already carries their audio and sending both would put the group in the room twice.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.4 — Remove "Prepare for Band Mode". It oscillated, for a topological reason rather than a coding one: Black In Bluhm sits on the master, so every source reached it twice — summed into the master mix on the dry path, and again individually through its ring on the wet path. Eight delayed copies against the original is comb filtering, and through a long FDN tail it rings. wet_norm also normalises for a single source, so eight arrive at up to eight times the intended level. Band mode wants the room on its own bus at 100% wet, which is a bigger change than a setup button. The diagnosis is kept in the source where the button was. The six plugin-visibility fixes from v2.3 are unaffected.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.5 — Room Verb builds the whole send/return in one click, which is the topology the removed band setup needed. Enable now makes a ROOM VERB bus, puts Black In Bluhm on it at 100% wet in Band mode, and places a Bluhm Send at the end of every top-level track's chain with a slot each. The tracks still go to the master, which is the direct sound; the sends publish into the rings, which is the room; and the bus has no audio routed into it, so nothing arrives twice. An existing room is moved rather than replaced, so a tuned room keeps its shape, and a room found on the master is reported as an insert with a button to rebuild it as a return. Disable removes the room, every send, and the bus if it is empty. "Send New Tracks" wires up tracks added later. Organize FX now sorts the whole chain instead of only moving the gate and RTW: generators, gate, pitch, pedals, amp, EQ and saturation, compression, reverb, RTW, then taps last — plugins sharing a stage keep the order you put them in, and non-LMS plugins are treated as post-amp tone. Also fixes Width, Depth, Height, Output Gain and Comp Input in the Room Verb tab, which read and wrote JSFX parameters as if they were normalised 0..1: a 5 m room displayed as 67 and dragging the slider set 0.23 m.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.6 — Room Verb also wires a real REAPER send from every source to the room bus, at -inf. It carries no audio and is not supposed to: the room hears the source ring, not the send. What it buys is order. REAPER's anticipative FX processing renders tracks ahead on separate threads by different amounts, and sources drifting that far from the bus is what made the finished room wobble — they timed out of the ring handshake one at a time and took their reflections with them. A receive makes the bus depend on its sources, so the routing graph keeps them together, and -inf means the dry path can never double the direct sound if the wet mix comes off 100%. Disable removes these sends along with everything else. Needs lms_core 7.6, which sizes the ring past the render-ahead.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.7 — Ring Diagnostics in the Room Verb tab. It reads the handshake table the sends and the room actually use and watches it change frame to frame: per slot, which track claims it, the publisher's heartbeat and write position with their deltas, the room's own liveness countdown and verdict, the lag between them, and how many times the slot has been seen dropping. Two track names on one slot is called out as a collision, a send on a folder child is called out as an orphan the setup skips and never renumbers, and the room's build stamp is shown so a stale compile is a fact on screen rather than an assumption. Strip All Sends clears every Bluhm Send including the ones setup skips. Built because the room reported a source count and nothing else, so "a source keeps dropping" had no way to become "which one, and why".

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.8 — Drag the band around the room plan. Each source has a hit target on the plan; dragging one proposes a position to the room, which clamps and applies it, so the placement that used to mean opening the plugin window happens where you are already looking. Requires lms_room 1.8. The hit targets are placed after the canvas is reserved so nothing below shifts, and the position is held inside the room while dragging — the room would clamp a wilder value itself, but then the dot fights the cursor, which reads as the drag being broken.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v2.9 — The ordering sends carry no MIDI. They exist to make the routing graph order two tracks and nothing else, and REAPER's default includes MIDI, which quietly copied every source's notes onto the room bus. Also drops the level rail under the room plan: the halo on each source dot already carries how loud it is arriving, so the bar beside it was the same reading twice. What remains is only what the plan cannot show — a slot that exists but is not being heard, and a slot two sends are fighting over.

version.author: LMS
version.changelog: v3.0 — An audit pass, worst first. Instances are checked against REAPER's track list once a frame: a track deleted in the UI left every instance pointing at freed memory, and with a one-second scan interval the manager could draw through those pointers for up to a second, which is a crash rather than a glitch. Drone Voice gains the registry entry it never had — it was in every other table and spawned by the Harmony tab, but drew as its lookup key with no category and never appeared in Track Setup. Track Setup builds chains in chain order instead of hash order, so a track comes out gate, pedals, amp, tone, strip, tap the first time rather than needing Organize afterwards. A track header's right-click menu and double-click rename worked only while it was expanded, for no visible reason; they read the header itself, so they now work collapsed too. The drone parameter sync writes only what differs: seven unconditional writes per voice per frame is not a CPU problem so much as an automation one, since a parameter under an armed write lane records a point on every write. And Send New Tracks targets the room bus rather than whichever track the room sits on, which differ in exactly the legacy case its own warning banner exists to catch.
